name: Test
overview: Scripture reveals that God tests His people to examine their hearts and faithfulness, as seen in His testing of Abraham and His scrutiny of the righteous and the wicked. The psalmist calls on the Lord to search and prove his inner being, highlighting a desire for divine evaluation. God also invites His people to test His faithfulness by obedience, promising abundant blessings for their trust and devotion. These tests serve both as trials of character and opportunities to experience God's strength and provision.
